v1.feedback: The piece successfully morphs the parent's differential growth rebound into a baldachin—the vertical stratification with anchored support columns and rising canopy fabric is legible and the ceremonial descent reframes the rebound mechanic well. The draping sag calculation and age-based lift create authentic canopy form. However, the palette (gold/bronze gradients) doesn't evoke the textile or stone materiality of actual baldachins; consider cooler stone grays or richer fabric burgundy/gold to strengthen the ceremonial architecture read. The anchor-to-fabric color transition could be more pronounced to emphasize the structural hierarchy.
